title: CJK text ods 001
notes: real CJK cells in ODF: the four verse lines of 静夜思 (Quiet Night Thought: 床前明月光，/ 疑是地上霜。/ 举头望明月，/ 低头思故乡。) in A1:A4, an 애국가 line 동해물과 백두산이 마르고 닳도록 in B1 and the Bashō haiku 古池や 蛙飛びこむ 水の音 in C1, exact strings byte-for-byte (same content as the odt/xlsx cjk fixtures). Every cell text:p references the named paragraph style "GP CJK" (shared with the odt builder) whose text-properties set style:font-name-asian="Noto Serif CJK SC" — the asian font-name slot, not the latin fo:font-name. Honest caveats: the one shared style tags zh/CN for all three scripts, so kana/Hangul substitution is renderer-font dependent (Noto CJK covers all three when installed); cell strings are stored un-normalized. The normative counter reads table:table=1. Reference text is the six visible cell strings in row-major order.
